+def _treasure_post_step(turn, state, pairs):
+    """Improve the next trip's start without leaving the assigned gun's ring.
+
+    This does not infer an opening date or leave defence to explore. In an
+    observed quiet night an already equipped pioneer can stand on a better
+    adjacent cell of the SAME gun, retaining next-round control distance.
+    """
+    robots = state.get('robot')
+    pioneer, base = turn.pioneer(), turn.station()
+    if (turn.is_day or (turn.round_no - 1) % 130 == 70 or state.get('phaseTask')
+            or pioneer is None or base is None or base.health < 1000
+            or not isinstance(robots, dict) or not isinstance(robots.get('roles'), list)
+            or any(robot.health > 0 for robot in turn.robots)
+            or any(enemy.health > 0 and enemy.kind in ('worker', 'pioneer')
+                   and distance(enemy.pos, pioneer.pos) <= 8 for enemy in turn.enemies)):
+        return None
+    notes = _treasure_notes(state, turn)
+    if (not notes.get('preparable') or notes.get('taken') or not notes.get('site')
+            or not notes.get('items') or Counter(notes['items']) - Counter(pioneer.backpack)):
+        return None
+    post = next((tower for role, tower in pairs if role.unit_id == pioneer.unit_id), None)
+    if post is None or distance(pioneer.pos, post.pos) > 1:
+        return None
+    site = Pos.load(notes['site'])
+    destinations = tuple(_stand_cells(turn, pioneer, site, set()))
+    routes = _RouteCost(turn, pioneer)
+    best = min(((routes(pioneer.pos, cell), cell.x, cell.y, cell) for cell in destinations), default=None)
+    if best is None or not 0 < best[0] < 10 ** 6:
+        return None
+    step = next_step(turn, pioneer, best[3])
+    if (step is None or distance(step, post.pos) > 1
+            or routes(step, best[3]) >= best[0]):
+        return None
+    return pioneer.unit_id, move_command(step)
+
